print_areas.art_spec: Upload 4500x5400 PNG @ 300dpi, transparent background. Center chest. Wordmark SIDESHOT in white. Underline: Start the Side Quest in #FF2D2D. No photoreal can art until SMI-151 lands.

Every can is a Side Quest. Wear the code.

Black Bella+Canvas 3001 retail-fit tee. Front lockup: SIDESHOT + Start the Side Quest.

skus.title: SIDESHOT Side Quest Dad Cap
skus.listing_title: SIDESHOT Side Quest Dad Cap — Embroidered 21+
skus.hold_colors_reason: Black only at launch. Navy / Dark Grey / White are catalog-ready if black embroidery contrast fails.

print_areas.art_spec: Simple SIDESHOT wordmark, max 2 thread colors (white + #FF2D2D or nearest red). No gradients, no photos, no 21+ microtype on the front. Embroidery digitizes poorly below ~0.25 in letter height.
Optional 21+ only. Skip if stitch quality looks cheap.

planning_cogs_usd.note: Public catalog 2026-08-27: embroidery from EUR 18.23 (EUR 13.48 Printify Premium). Shipping verified: US first $4.49 / addl $2.09. Recheck USD print cost in editor at publish.

skus.title: SIDESHOT Side Quest Can Cooler
skus.hold_sizes_reason: Slim Can is catalog-ready. Hold until we sell 12oz branded cans; Regular Can matches Phase 1 standard 12oz.

print_areas.art_spec: Edge-to-edge wrap. Black field, red-orange SIDESHOT lockup, Start the Side Quest, small 21+ on the seam. Fits standard 12oz cans (3.5 x 4.3 in). Polyester face / foam liner.

planning_cogs_usd.note: Standalone first-item US shipping ($5.39) eats margin. Prefer cart add-on / bundle with tee or future SafeShot. Additional koozies ship $0.89. Public catalog 2026-08-27: from EUR 3.93 (EUR 2.85 Premium).

skus.standalone_margin_warning: First-item US ship $5.39 + ~$4.50 print ≈ $9.90 COGS vs $16 retail (~38% before fees). Do not discount below $14 standalone.
skus.description:
Keep the 12oz cold. Keep the Side Quest moving.

21+ only. Drink responsibly. Never force consumption.
